analysis: Native AV1 base plus zlib signed16 corrections reconstructs every source I420 sample exactly using WebGL2 integer textures/shader and full readback oracle. All3 pictures, base-identity guards, decoded frame cleanup and GPU owner destruction pass over7 alternating fresh jobs. Complete measured local preparation+decode+GPU jobs cost median1.3246x direct native lossless and payload9732 versus6471bytes. Stop this same-grid8bit profile. No HDR/upsampling, physical hardware decoder, arbitrary base portability or generic player integration claim. Local input bytes were already available before browser clocks; source/base hashes bind corrections. Cost includes host encode/decode verification/correction production and browser decompression/upload/reconstruction/readback, excludes final cleanup from both timed jobs. That extra candidate cleanup cannot rescue the measured regression.
